subject: Integration sprint schedule + canary checklist — Aurora Health (Post-signature)
thread_content:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ava Patel <ava.patel@aurorahealth.com>, Diego Rivera <diego.rivera@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Integration sprint schedule + canary checklist — Aurora Health (Post-signature)

Hi Ava / Diego —

Congrats again on the signature — excited to get Aurora Health onto Redwood. Attached is a first-draft mutual action plan (MAP) that embeds the post-signature implementation timeline, a proposed sprint cadence, and a canary checklist for the initial rollout. High-level asks here:

- Proposed timeline: 6-week implementation window starting July 5 (week-by-week milestones in the MAP attachment).
- Canary window: Week 3 (July 19–23) for a controlled ramp from 1% to 10% traffic on the integration path.
- Migration strategy: phased cutover by endpoint (patient-summaries -> appointment-notifs -> billing-embeds) to limit blast radius.
- Training: two 90-minute sessions for engineering + product (dates proposed in doc).
- Success criteria: latency < 400ms P95 for production samples during canary, error rate < 0.5%, and no data residency violations.

Please review the MAP and the attached canary checklist (aurora_canary_checklist_v1.xlsx). Specific items we need from Aurora to lock dates:
1) Confirm the preferred migration weekend (we proposed Aug 7–8).
2) Confirm the small pilot dataset (approx. 1–2% of traffic) that we should use for the canary run.
3) Any compliance constraints (e.g., required audit logs retention longer than standard) so we can adjust the Private deployment options.

Next steps: if the dates look ok I’ll schedule the kickoff for Jun 18 and loop in CS and billing for contract activation.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachment: aurora_canary_checklist_v1.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 24KB)
Attachment: integration_sequence_diagram.png (PNG, 420KB)

From: Ava Patel <ava.patel@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Rivera <diego.rivera@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration sprint schedule + canary checklist — Aurora Health (Post-signature)

Thanks Marissa — this is great and very helpful. A couple of quick asks/notes from our side before we sign off on dates:

- Can we move the kickoff to Jun 21 instead of Jun 18? Our Q2 close activities bumped the team schedule.
- For the canary dataset, we prefer the appointment-notifs stream for the initial run (lower sensitivity than full patient summaries).
- Compliance: Aurora requires 3 years of audit log retention for inference requests tied to patient IDs. Can Redwood support that retention on Private?
- Procurement: need a single consolidated invoice for the first 90 days and a PO reference — I’ll share the PO number once finance completes the internal approval (ETA Jun 18).

I’ve copied our integration lead Diego — he’ll coordinate the pilot dataset and provide the sample dataset token. Also looping in Karthik for technical questions.

Best,
Ava
Ava Patel
Head of Integrations | Aurora Health
ava.patel@aurorahealth.com | +1 617-555-0198

On Mon, 14 Jun 2027 at 09:45 AM, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Ava — moving kickoff to Jun 21 works for the Redwood infra team.
> 
> A few clarifications / technical commitments from us (so they are explicit in the MAP):
> 
> - Canary checklist (summary):
>   * Staging smoke: end-to-end inference with sample payloads (pass/fail).
>   * KV cache warmup: pre-warm using a 24-hour representative request set.
>   * Load phases: 1% -> 3% -> 10% over 3 days with health checks at each step.
>   * Rollback criteria: sustained >1% error rate for 30 minutes OR P95 latency > 600ms for 15 minutes.
>   * Observability: we will give Aurora a live dashboard URL and a token with read-only access for the canary week.
> 
> - Migration cutover plan: we recommend endpoint-by-endpoint cutover with a final switch on the migration weekend. We will run a dress rehearsal in staging one week prior.
> 
> - Data residency: Private deployment supports custom retention; we will surface a SOC2-friendly audit-log export for your security team. I’ll work with Rishi on the retention SLA.
> 
> I attached the canary checklist (same workbook Marissa referenced) and an integration diagram for reference.
> 
> Action items for Aurora: send the pilot dataset token and confirm the migration weekend if Aug 7–8 still looks OK.
> 
> —Karthik
> Karthik Iyer
> Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
> karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Quick finance note: the deal setup team needs the following to start provisioning Dedicated capacity and issue the consolidated invoice Ava requested:

1) Final PO number (from Aurora finance).
2) Start date for reserved capacity (we propose Aug 1 to cover the migration weekend).
3) Billing contact (please confirm if billing@aurorahealth.com is preferred).

Also, for the MAP we should call out the price for the 90-day onboarding commitment vs. the annual reserved SKU; that will help Aurora decide whether to start reserved capacity immediately or ramp after the onboarding window. I’ll draft the two options and send to Lauren to include in the MAP.

Rishi

Marissa / Karthik —

All sounds good on our side. Confirming:
- Kickoff: Jun 21 (please send calendar invite).
- Pilot dataset: we will provide an appointment-notifs stream sample (token sent to Karthik via secure upload).
- Migration weekend: Aug 7–8 is acceptable but we prefer Aug 14–15 if Redwood needs an extra week after the dress rehearsal.
- Audit logs: Aurora will accept the SOC2-friendly audit export, but we will need a written confirmation of the 3-year retention in the SOW appendix.

We will review the canary checklist and provide comments by EOD Jun 16. If that timeline works we can lock the August migration weekend on Jun 18.

Diego Rivera
